note: *Escutai a palavra do Senhor, nações* against the line every Brazilian text has, *Ouvi, nações* (LH, Lectionary, MS1932, Diurnal): bare *ouvi* is also 'I heard' (the *audíre* row, D13).
*do mais poderoso* was heard as a superlative by the blind reader; the stylist asked *do mais forte* (*fortis*'s word). *de quem era mais poderoso* the option.
*a virgem em coro*, as 149:3; DRB, MS1932 and the CNBB all read a dance here. The blind reader heard singing only. *na dança* the option.
*em júbilo* (the open *gáudium* row, 29:12): the Latinist asked *alegria*, the stylist *regozijo*. Also *depois da sua dor*: both gates call *a dolóre* separative; *livres da sua dor* the option.
